name: reelscribe-mobile
description: ReelScribe iOS and Android shell with on-device transcription, OCR and native file sharing.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run sync:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run sync:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync
scripts.open:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
